items.title: Iran accuses US of 'reckless military adventure'
items.description: Abbas Araghchi says the US attacks each time there is a diplomatic solution on the table.

items.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine to observe three-day ceasefire
items.description: It comes as the two countries accused each other of violating separate ceasefires to cover the celebrations of the Soviet Union's victory over Nazi Germany.

items.title: Worldwide race to trace passengers from hantavirus-hit cruise ship
items.description: About 12 countries have so far been linked to the hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius, as the UN health agency confirms at least five cases.

items.title: Greece examines mystery naval drone found in Ionian Sea
items.description: Greek media say the drone, which reportedly had explosives, could be either Ukrainian or linked to the Russia-Ukraine war.

items.title: Hovering objects and flashing lights: what we learned from UFO documents released by the Pentagon
items.description: The US has published transcripts, video clips and audio recordings about unidentified flying objects, also called unidentified anomalous phenomena.

items.title: International cyber attack disrupts swathe of universities and schools
items.description: A hacking group breached the academic software Canvas, used by thousands of schools and universities across the globe.

items.title: Three dead after volcano erupts on Indonesian island
items.description: Officials had previously issued warnings on climbing the active volcano due to safety concerns.

items.title: White House calls Mark Hamill 'sick' after actor's Trump grave post
items.description: The Star Wars actor apologised and deleted the post, which contained an AI image of the president in a shallow grave.

items.title: Oil prices rise after US and Iran exchange fire in Hormuz strait
items.description: US President Donald Trump says the ceasefire between Washington and Tehran is still in place.

items.title: South Africa president faces call to resign after court ruling
items.description: The Constitutional Court says MPs were was wrong to block impeachment proceedings against Cyril Ramaphosa.

items.title: Third British national has suspected hantavirus infection, UK government says
items.description: Five cases of hantavirus have been confirmed in total, including one of the three passengers on the MV Hondius who died.

items.title: US jet fuel could be used in Europe to ease possible shortages
items.description: An international air body suggests wider acceptance of US-grade jet fuel could help to head off any supply problems.
